_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Leg is flat inside the Anxiety–Complacency boundary with no coil-breaker; base rate favors HOLD until fear_greed or ETF/funding impulse forces a rung change.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly forwards Complacency/HOLD; narrative silent on phase so no direct conflict
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed holds 45-54 and BTC 30d change stays near flat without an ETF-flow or funding impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks below 39 or above 55, or etf_flows reverse hard while 30d momentum leaves the flatline
